measure: One green receipt, vm-cc7cf483e850489387faf6d878bc6312 (aweb 6a460770f9, 12-CPU merak guest, every lane at once). CPU-seconds: the cumulative usage_usec of every container's cpu.stat in its memory.jsonl, attributed to a lane by name (its runner, Postgres and Redis, and the containers it started) and to a unit suite by its isolated runner and the services in that runner's network namespace. The run's shared builder (509) and static (201) are in no lane; 60 CPU-s in one unlabelled sibling (aweb-cross-reg) are attributed to none. Short-lived containers between samples are undercounted. Workers and elapsed seconds are that run's: each lane other than unit ran one process; unit's suites ran in its plan (test-server 4 xdist workers, test-naapp-lib serial, the serial suites in a pool of 3 slots), after 733 s of setup (node deps, aw, and the suite image build). A part's workers per busy CPU is workers x elapsed / CPU-seconds (the pool's: its slot-seconds / CPU-seconds). The pool's longest suite, test-naapp-secrets at 1640 s, bounds how fast the pool can finish.

cloud.measure: CPU-seconds from cgroups, as aweb's lanes: the cumulative usage_usec of every container's cpu.stat in the receipt's memory.jsonl, from a full green `vm-gate cloud-gate` on a 12-CPU merak guest. backend+frontend is their shared runner (13177) plus its Postgres and Redis (2623); cloud-user-journey is its stage runner, stack, Hermes containers and DNS sidecars; image includes the run's builder. Lane figures are rounded. aweb's weight is the sum of this file's lanes.
